title.zh: 宣布Kalinga-Apayao Balbalan的Balbalasang村为旅游度假区，划出其中部分公共土地为国家公园，并授权拨款10万比索作为改善该国家公园的初始款项
title.en: An Act Declaring the Barrio of Balbalasang, Balbalan, Kalinga-Apayao as a Tourist Resort, Setting Aside Certain Portions of the Public Domain Therein as a National Park, and Authorizing the Appropriation of One Hundred Thousand Pesos as Initial Amount for the Improvement of Said National Park
title.orig: An Act Declaring the Barrio of Balbalasang, Balbalan, Kalinga-Apayao as a Tourist Resort, Setting Aside Certain Portions of the Public Domain Therein as a National Park, and Authorizing the Appropriation of One Hundred Thousand Pesos as Initial Amount for the Improvement of Said National Park

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1972/ra_6463_1972.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The barrio of Balbalasang, Balbalan, Kalinga-Apayao, is hereby declared a tourist resort, and certain portions of the public domains therein which may be selected by the Commission on Parks and Wildlife within one year from the effectivity of this Act is hereby declared, subject to the approval of the President, a national park.

The sum of one hundred thousand pesos is authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated for the establishment, operation and maintenance of said tourist spot and national park during the fiscal year nineteen hundred and seventy-four. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for their operation and maintenance shall be included in the amount General Appropriations Act,

This. Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted without Executive approval, June 17, 1972.
